notes.title: [v1.2.0] Multiplayer Update, and 1-Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Today marks exactly 1 year since the official release of REDSHOT! I've had so much fun working on this game over the past year and beyond, and I want to thank everybody for their support with this major free update adding up to 4 player local co-op and a host of other improvements. Online play should work with steam remote play, but I have not personally tested this.

Huge thanks to everyone who has bought and played the game, or otherwise supported me making this silly little thing over the years. Looking back over the past year since release there's been many things I think I could have done better at the time, but I think the game is in the best state its ever been and I personally still have fun playing it after hundreds of hours of work and playtesting, and now with multiplayer support, the potential longevity of the game has increased massively.

Thank you for playing and enjoy the update! Full patch notes below:

[list]
[*] Adds up to 4 player local co-op to the game. Simply plug in an additional controller and press the start button when at any save point in the game. 
[*] Improve jumping physics
[*] Improve keyboard controls and fix bug that wouldn't let the player ascend/descend in water with scuba gear using mouse and keyboard controls
[*] Improve environment lighting in certain areas
[*] Various audio improvements
[*] Improve controller vibration
[*] General performance improvements, especially in large rooms with many npcs
[*] Autoheal now works with beer
[*] Fix some rare crashes
[*] Save points now longer restore health on hard and extreme modes
[*] Many, many, many more bug fixes and various improvements that aren't significant enough to list here
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE ROADMAP
notes.notes:
Hey all, I just wanted to announce my plans for the major content updates and free DLC for REDSHOT. The dates and features listed here are tentative and not set in stone, but offer a general estimation of what I currently have planned for the future. 

In addition to the content listed below, each major update will come with regular bug fixes and improvements.


[h2]WINTER 2023:[/h2]
[h3][v1.1] Bounceball Update[/h3]
This update brings 4 new bounceball arenas to the game, a bounceball tournament side quest, and improvements to the bounceball minigame. Winning each tournament will give the player the choice of health, stamina or ammo upgrades.

[h2]SPRING 2023:[/h2]
[h3][v1.2] Multiplayer Update[/h3]
This update will bring 4 player local multiplayer support to REDSHOT in the form of co-op and versus modes. Co-op will be drop in/drop out at any time during the main campaign. Versus mode will offer deathmatch, capture the flag, and bounceball modes.

[h2]SUMMER/FALL 2023:[/h2]
[h3][v1.5] Free Epilogue DLC[/h3]
This is the final planned content update for the game, bringing an expanded ending, new area(s), new weapons, new enemies, and new bosses. In addition, this update will upgrade the underlying engine version from Gamemaker Studio 2.25 to the latest 2022.x release, and will coincide with release of a switch port(and possibly xbox/playstation ports as well). All updates following this one will be bug fixes only, and will offer no new features or additional content.

notes.title: [v1.03] Speedrunning update, Side quest fixes, and more
notes.notes:
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[h2][v1.03][/h2]

This is a smallish to moderate patch that fixes a number of the most requested bugs, and adds some new options to the settings.ini specifically for speedrunners. I fixed the door skip, it wasn't as rare as I thought, and people were discovering it accidentally too often, so I had to fix it. But I also added an in-game timer and an option to skip text scrolling in the settings.ini file. Additionally, more bug fixes. Full patch notes below.

NOTE: Hoping to have steam achievements ready for the next patch by the end of next week.

[list]
[*] Fix crash from buying a gold key from the shop in snowpeak area
[*] Fix miles infinitely spawning reward after sand worm boss (this was a typo... '-_-)
[*] Fix door skips (collision skip, and the bullet skip)
[*] Add fast text and show timer options to settings.ini (more on this below)
[*] Fix dog not following you between rooms
[*] Final boss now has 50% more health (offset by the fact you can now bring a follower to ease the challenge a bit if you're having trouble)
[*] Stop NPCs from attacking bosses if they are talking to the player
[*] Fix playtime not stopping while on the title screen/main menu
[*] Fix ship sometimes not appearing in the landing site room after completing the game
[*] Warp points now reset after starting new game plus
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

[h3]For Speedrunners[/h3]
Since the new options are only for speedrunners and aren't intended to be used for casual playthroughs of the game, these new options are only available to change in the settings.ini, and not in the in-game options menu. 

To access the settings.ini file, press the windows key + R to bring up the "Run" window. In the box that pops up, copy and paste "%localappdata%" without the quote marks and hit OK. This will open an explorer window with your local app data files. In this folder, there should be a folder called "REDSHOT", as long as you have started the game at least once. In here are your save files and the settings.ini.

Inside the settings.ini file, there will be section called "Speedrunning". In here are your two options: Fast text to skip the letter-by-letter scrolling during dialogue, reducing the required button mashing, and Show Timer, which will show the in-game timer in the top right hand corner of the screen during gameplay. Change the 0 before the decimal point to a 1 to turn the option on. Change it back to a 0 to turn the option off again. And don't forget to save the file!

I may add these to the in-game options menu at a later point, but for now, this should be fine.

notes.notes:
[h3]DISCLAIMER FOR YOUTUBERS: [/h3]
It has come to my attention that my music distributor is copyright claiming the background music in game footage when uploading to YouTube. They will not take your videos down or anything but if you'd like to monetize your videos, please turn OFF the music in the game options before recording your footage until I get this sorted out with the distribution company. As far as I know this only applies to YouTube, so twitch streaming should be completely fine with the background music. Sorry about this, I will try to resolve it as quickly as possible.
